record.body:
## Description

Finish test module renames/imports and any remaining sync-script or helper references so the rename surface is green under pytest for the touched tests.

## Approach

1. Rename or rewrite `tests/test_se_workflow_*.py` (and imports) to `affidavit` / `aff`.
2. Fix helpers/conftest strings that still assume `se_workflow` or `bin/se-workflow`.
3. Confirm `scripts/sync-plugin.sh` targets the affidavit plugin path/name.
4. Run the renamed unit/CLI tests that this phase owns; leave unrelated suite failures alone.

payload.title: Rename tests and sync paths for affidavit
